scenarios.context: Two coworkers talk about their hobbies.

speakerA.en: What do you like to do in your free time?
That's interesting. Do you sell your paintings?
I play the guitar and I'm learning to sing.

speakerB.en: I love painting. I paint every Sunday.
No, it's just a hobby. What about you?
Wonderful! Maybe we can play together one day.

speakerA.en: I want to join a sports club. Do you know a good one?

speakerB.en: There's a tennis club near my house.
Not really. It's forty dollars a month.
Yes, they have lessons on Mondays and Wednesdays.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk on Monday morning.

speakerA.en: Did you do anything fun last weekend?
Sounds great. Did you go fishing?

speakerB.en: Yes, we went camping near the lake.
We did, but we didn't catch anything.
A little, but the stars were beautiful.

speakerA.en: Have you seen the new one at the cinema?
Sure. What time does it start?

speakerB.en: Yes, especially comedies. I watch one every Friday.
Not yet. Do you want to go together on Saturday?
At eight. Let's meet at seven thirty.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk about this year.

speakerA.en: I'm going to learn cooking this year.
Yes, a class starts next month.
Pasta, I think. It looks easy.

speakerB.en: That's a great hobby. Are you going to take a class?
What are you going to cook first?
Invite me when you're ready to cook for guests!
